name: backlink-autofill
description: Project-isolated backlink submission workflow that uses the current Codex/ChatGPT model, Google Sheets queue state, browser tools, one shared submitter profile, and selected-project-only assets without a separate LLM API.

interface.shortDescription: Run isolated backlink submissions from a Google Sheets queue
interface.longDescription: Select one project explicitly, read only that project's rows from the shared backlink control spreadsheet, combine reviewed project data and private assets with one shared submitter profile, and execute backlink form work with evidence-backed status updates.
defaultPrompt: Use $backlink-autofill for the selected project and work from its pending rows in the backlink control spreadsheet
